name: Blue-stem willow
desc: Blue-stem willow (Salix irrorata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Salix irrorata, the dewystem willow, blue-stem willow, or sandbar willow, is a species of willow native to the US states of Wyoming, Colorado, Arizona, and New Mexico, and to northern Mexico.
